name: Octo-Base
family: Generalist transformer policy with a diffusion action head

sources.title: Octo Model Team, Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy, arXiv:2405.12213
sources.covers: the 256 × 256 third-person and 128 × 128 wrist inputs, 16 × 16 patches, tokens per image, two frames of history, temporal ensembling, per-setup control rates

sources.title: octo-models/octo (official code), commit 241fb35: README.md and octo/utils/gym_wrappers.py
sources.covers: the inference rate on an NVIDIA 4090, the action chunk of 4, the crop and resize done at inference (ResizeImageWrapper)

note: Octo's primary (third-person) image is cropped and resized to 256 × 256 (16 × 16 patches, 256 tokens); the wrist image is resized to 128 × 128 with no crop (64 tokens). At inference the official wrapper takes the average of the training crop: a centred crop of √0.9 = 0.949 of each side, then a resize, for the primary image only. The README's 13 it/sec on one NVIDIA 4090 is Octo-Base (Octo-Small: 17 it/sec). The number of cameras is not fixed (a primary and a wrist slot; either can be masked). Two observation frames of history. Code MIT.

input_resolution.quote: "For the 3rd person camera we apply stochastic crops followed be a resize to 256×256"

crop_rule.quote: ResizeImageWrapper: "we crop and resize the image with bilinear interpolation to match the average of the crop and resize image augmentation performed during training" (augmented_keys=("image_primary",))

crop_side_fraction.quote: avg_scale: float = 0.9, avg_ratio: float = 1.0; new_height = sqrt(avg_scale / avg_ratio), new_width = sqrt(avg_scale * avg_ratio), centred

patch_px.quote: "split into a sequence of flattened patches [22] of size 16×16" (Appendix D)

tokens_per_image.quote: "This results in 256 tokens for the 3rd person camera images and 64 tokens for the wrist camera images."

wrist_input_resolution.quote: "For the wrist camera, we apply the same procedure except without the random crop and resizing to 128×128 instead."

wrist_tokens_per_image.quote: "64 tokens for the wrist camera images"

n_cameras.quote: Not fixed: the checkpoints "support multiple RGB camera inputs" (image_primary and image_wrist slots).

action_chunk.quote: "Octo was pretrained with an action chunking size of 4, meaning it predicts the next 4 actions at once."

execute_steps.quote: Your choice: "execute all these actions before sampling new ones, or only execute the first action" (README).

temporal_ensemble_m.quote: Optional (TemporalEnsembleWrapper, exp_weight default 0); the paper: "we did not find temporal ensembling of future actions to provide additional benefits beyond receding horizon control".

control_hz.quote: Not one figure: 5-15 Hz across the paper's fine-tuning setups (CMU Baking 15 Hz, Stanford Coffee 10 Hz, Berkeley Peg Insertion 5 Hz).
